message: 商店街のアイドル？

name: Sally
message: 「Kyuuu~, I lost~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Justice always prevails!」

name: Sally
message: 「I was just hungry, that's all!」

name: Sally
message: 「What's your deal! It's not like I ate the pickled radish for free! I was gonna leave this in exchange, you're so mean!」

name: Synn
message: 「What... is this?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Beats me...?」

name: Sally
message: 「You guys must be living under a rock if you don't know henuporusupukuru, the hottest craze in the Demon World! Look, if you do this, and this, and this, it makes a funny shape.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Is that really funny?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not funny.」

name: Sally
message: 「Kiii!」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, bartering just doesn't cut it here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe that's how the world goes round in the Demon World, but over here, money makes the world go round.」

name: Sally
message: 「Spouting all that sophistry just to bully us! You'll regret this, Student Council!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Right now, we're more like Crusaders than the Student Council.」

name: Sally
message: 「Shut up, shut up!」
Sally-chan scooped up Mochimochi, Jangara, and Tinun and flew away.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, wait--well, if they fly away, we can't exactly chase them.」
Undoing their transformations together, they let out a sigh of relief.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, all's well that ends well. Nobody got hurt, at least.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, but they dined and dashed on us... *sigh*」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Never mind about that!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, really, we didn't even get the money from them.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「More importantly, what was up with that bizarre cosplay?! And on both of you, no less!」

name: Nanaka & Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I got a great shot on my phone! Still, I never would've guessed you two were into the kind of hobby where you gather at a landfill twice a year.」
The Crusaders' outfits really might look the part, now that I think about it...

name: Synn
message: 「No, those outfits aren't that kind of thing--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-This is bad, Synn! When Auntie's eyes sparkle like that, she won't let us go until she's satisfied!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. That's right!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Where'd you get 'em, the otaku holy land? Or was it the jungle?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's nothing like that--」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Or could they actually be handmade?! Oh, is that it, they're handmade?! Are you two really in that deep?!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Then you're already beyond saving. Though it's the truth, so it can't be helped.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Beyond saving from what?!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Why, once you become an otaku, it's a straight shot to becoming a freeter or a NEET, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「...That's way too extreme, Auntie.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's totally biased! Weren't you supposed to be an apostle of truth?!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Well, the future doesn't really matter for now, anyway. More importantly, if you're cosplaying in matching outfits, could it be the two of you are already in that kind of relationship?!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Kufufu. Now isn't that huge news! I'd better go tell the whole shopping district right away♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, stop that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Auntie. Those aren't cosplay. They're uniforms.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Uniforms?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's for interaction between academy students and locals, you see. Starting this year, the Student Council is doing volunteer work, and those are the uniforms we wear for it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right! That's what they are!」

name: Synn
message: 「People won't remember us if we don't stand out, right? So we tried making them a little flashy.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「...I see. So that's how it is.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's how it is.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh-huh.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「It suited you pretty well, though. Well then, we've got to spread the word around the shopping district right away! With a huge photo and everything!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not yet. We've only just started our activities.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh, come on, don't hold back... Whoa!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady, this way.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, Mr. President!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, did you happen to see the Demons?」

name: Synn
message: 「They were here just a moment ago, but.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We drove 'em off in no time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then I ran all the way here for nothing. Leaving at least one behind would have been the kind thing to do.」

name: Misa
message: 「Where are the Demons!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Looks like they're gone.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oooooh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Apparently, Mr. President defeated them with a slash-slash-squish-crack-splat-squelch.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Like smashing a black gentleman over and over and over again with the bottom of a slipper. How barbaric.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. What a brutal thing I've done!」

name: Ria
message: 「...That might be going a little too far.\s02」

name: Misa
message: 「This is why men are... Sister, you mustn't go near such a terrifying person.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I've just got to get a picture of this!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We literally just chased them off. There's no way Synn could pull off something like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Now that you mention it, that's true. You really surprised me for a second, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun is entirely capable of it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They do say a wise man changes like a leopard, after all.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Snap, snap, snap!」

name: Synn
message: 「...By the way, everyone, did you manage to gather the recycling items?」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course! And what about you, Sakura-kun...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What matters for items at a bazaar isn't quantity, it's quality! I may have lost in quantity, but I haven't lost in quality! This match is a draw!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. We got a whole bunch. What about you, Lolotte-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There were so many options that I couldn't choose.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's no good. Besides, we're not out shopping here.」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Snap, snap, snap!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, stop sneaking photos!」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「I'm an apostle of truth, after all. Still, I see how it is. The designs are all slightly different, yet there's a strange sense of unity to them. Haha. Hehe. Ho-ho.」

name: Synn & Nanaka
message: 「Stop taking pictures!」
